name: The GWEN
positioning: Art Deco-inspired hotel in the historic McGraw-Hill Building on Chicago's Michigan Avenue (officially The Gwen, a Luxury Collection Hotel, Michigan Avenue Chicago)
best_for: Travelers who want a Michigan Avenue base within walking distance of the Magnificent Mile
Guests drawn to 1930s-inspired Art Deco design and a rooftop with skyline views

facts.text: The hotel's Art Deco-infused facade was crafted by sculptress Gwen Lux in the historic McGraw-Hill Building.
The hotel channels the vintage glamour of 1930s Chicago with contemporary elegance.
The rooms feature original artwork honoring the hotel's namesake, sculptress Gwen Lux.
Guest rooms feature custom murals on upholstered headboards.
Bathrooms have marble finishes, a walk-in shower, Molton Brown toiletries and Frette bathrobes.
Each room has a Luxury Collection bed with a pillowtop mattress and elegant linens.
The hotel has direct, enclosed access to The Shops at North Bridge.
The hotel is on Chicago's Michigan Avenue, within walking distance of shopping and restaurants on the Magnificent Mile.
The concierge team is a Les Clefs d'Or team that provides personalized recommendations, exclusive access and itineraries.
Upstairs at The Gwen is an Art Deco-inspired rooftop retreat with skyline views.
Guests can request a fifth-floor room for convenient rooftop access.
The fitness center is equipped with two Peloton bikes and a Tonal.

highlights.text: Guests can go glamping on the private terrace of the Gwen Lux Suite on the 16th floor of the historic McGraw-Hill building, with a multi-bedroom suite and a glamping tent.
Suites offer views of the Magnificent Mile and the River North skyline.
Upstairs at The Gwen extends patio season into the winter with warm drinks, fire pits and curling.
The 5th-floor lobby has a Moet and Chandon champagne vending machine.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 21.
The hotel charges a daily destination fee, which covers amenities such as complimentary bikes.
WhataHotel notes typical city noise levels for an urban location.
